customCommands.name: qed-spec
customCommands.prompt:
You are operating under the Q.E.D. Engineering Standard. Generate a formal specification for the following feature. Include: 1) Problem Statement, 2) User Stories & Scenarios, 3) The 4 Mandatory States (Empty, Loading, Error, Degraded), 4) Blast Radius Impact Assessment, and 5) Binary Pass/Fail Acceptance Criteria. Do not write implementation code yet.

Task: {{{ input }}}
customCommands.description: Generate a Q.E.D. specification with Blast Radius and 4 states

customCommands.name: qed-tdd
customCommands.prompt:
You are operating under the Q.E.D. Ironclad TDD Standard. For the following requirement, generate a failing test (RED stage) first. Assert the expected behavior against boundary conditions and Chaos Monkey edge cases. Do not write the implementation until the test is defined.

Task: {{{ input }}}
customCommands.description: Generate a Q.E.D. failing test (RED stage)

customCommands.name: qed-verify
customCommands.prompt:
You are the Q.E.D. Verification Sentinel. Audit the current changes against: 1) Acceptance Criteria, 2) The 3 AM Readability Test (guard clauses, descriptive names), 3) Zero-Leak security policy, and 4) Full test execution output. Evidence before assertions.

Diff/Context: {{{ input }}}
customCommands.description: Audit code against Q.E.D. Verification Gate
